nights.title: Infinity Song
nights.name: Infinity Song
nights.extract: Infinity Song is an American soft rock band composed of siblings Abraham, Angel, Israel and Momo Boyd. Based in New York City, the group has released three albums under record label Roc Nation.

nights.title: Aşkın Nur Yengi
nights.name: Aşkın Nur Yengi
nights.extract:
Aşkın Nur Yengi is a Turkish singer, composer, and actress.
She started working as a backing vocalist for Sezen Aksu and with Aksu's help, released her first studio album in 1990. With her debut album Sevgiliye in 1990, she became one of the most successful Turkish singers of the '90s.

de.who: Aşkın Nur Yengi ist eine türkische Sängerin, Komponistin und Schauspielerin. Sie begann als Background-Sängerin für Sezen Aksu, und mit Aksus Hilfe veröffentlichte sie 1990 ihr erstes Studioalbum. Mit ihrem Debütalbum Sevgiliye im Jahr 1990 wurde sie eine der erfolgreichsten türkischen Sängerinnen der 90er.

tr.who: Aşkın Nur Yengi bir Türk şarkıcı, besteci ve oyuncudur. Sezen Aksu'nun arka plan vokalisti olarak çalışmaya başladı ve Aksu'nun desteğiyle ilk stüdyo albümünü 1990'da yayımladı. 1990'da çıkardığı Sevgiliye adlı ilk albümüyle 90'ların en başarılı Türk şarkıcılarından biri oldu.

nights.title: Demet Akalın
nights.name: Demet Akalın
nights.extract: Demet Akalın is a Turkish singer and former model. Due to the popular songs she has released since the middle of the 2000s, she has become a prominent figure in Turkish pop music.
